name: event-photo-share
description: Event photography delivery: shoot, finish group, hand the guest a QR code.

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @eps/desktop
scripts.dev:gallery: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @eps/gallery
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @eps/desktop && npm run build -w @eps/gallery
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:core && npm run dist:mac -w @eps/desktop
scripts.dist:mac:notarized: npm run build:core && npm run dist:mac:notarized -w @eps/desktop && ./scripts/notarize-dmg.sh
